note: English round 3, held out, statement-heavy: written on 2026-09-26 after a review found that English status messages ('Daily report for yesterday was wrong', 'Draft approved', 'you reviewed') ran as requests and that context before the deliverable ('For the tender, draft a method statement') picked the post. Written before the fix for that review was implemented and before any version of the rules ran on these sentences. Not blind: the same agent then wrote the fix, having read the review's probe sentences (none of which is repeated here). SYNTHETIC: written for this benchmark in the voice of a Singapore curtain-wall (facade) contractor's site, logistics and tender staff; nothing comes from a real company, project or document. Two thirds are statements, notices and reported past work that must stay chat; the requests put context before the deliverable. `post` is scored only on run/both rows.
